description:
Hushfacebook v0.16.2 targets Facebook 583.0.0.39.55 (com.facebook.katana) with Tablet & Galaxy Z Fold layout support for Xiaomi Pad 6 and other tablets.

### Added
* **Navigation:** Added 'Tablet and foldable layout on big screens' (Bố cục máy tính bảng và màn hình gập) in Appearance settings. Forces Facebook's big screen layout gate and spoofs Galaxy Z Fold 5 (SM-F946B) to activate multi-pane / centered layout instead of stretched phone UI.
